parameters.query: SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(json_build_object('d', to_char(measured_on,'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'v', value) ORDER BY measured_on), '[]'::json) AS points, count(*) AS n FROM measurement WHERE bot_id=$1 AND user_id=$2 AND metric = ANY($3::text[]) AND measured_on >= (now()-interval '180 days')::date;
